extras: Android only. Requires Termux and a companion app.
intentEvidence: none of them works with a native sparse-checkout index, which is the entire reason this one exists
motivation: The author built it because existing mobile Git implementations (like isomorphic-git) do not understand native Git indices, leading to misreading sparse omissions as mass deletions.
problem: Existing mobile Git implementations fail to correctly handle native Git features like sparse-checkout, often misinterpreting sparse omissions as mass deletions.
